description: Refresh GitHub Actions workflow files from their baseline templates, preserving Renovate-managed values (action refs, container image tags, ruby versions, runner images, ...) already present in the repo. Template text is canonical; values are grafted via Psych node coordinates, so comments and formatting are never disturbed.

workflows.description: Workflow files to merge: [{path: <target file>, template: <baseline content>}, ...]

preserve_keys.description: YAML mapping keys whose scalar values are Renovate-managed and must be preserved from the existing file (default: uses, image, container, ruby-version, runs-on)

preserve_blocks.description: Dot-paths of mapping blocks the EXISTING file is authoritative for (e.g. ['jobs.acceptance']): its block replaces the template's, is appended when the template lacks it, and the template's block is removed when the existing file has none

template_steps.description: Names of steps the template stays authoritative for inside preserved_blocks: each of a preserved job's steps with one of these names is replaced in place by the template's step of that name, and named steps the job lacks go in next to their template neighbours. A preserved job with none of them is left alone. Fails if the template's job lacks a name
